messages.subject: fileInput for InternetExplorer9 on latest shiny installation
parts:
I have recent versions of shiny and shinydashboard.

My app did not work for a client using Internet Explorer9 to upload a file.

I was able to show him it does work over a webinar, but I was using Internet Explorer 11.

I saw the fileInput for Internet Explorer9 was fixed in shiny 10.2, just wondering if this was an issue in the latest version

from sessioninfo on the server running the app:
other attached packages:
[1] shinydashboard_0.5.1 shiny_0.12.0


Thanks,
Mike

messages.author: e9ea40ad71e07dc0
messages.subject: Re: fileInput for InternetExplorer9 on latest shiny installation
parts:
Here is an excerpt of by code on the UI side, not sure if it matters, but I am uploading an xlsx file using xslx package  

```
 tabPanel('2. Upload Edited Program Inventory',
        fluidRow(column(12,h4(strong('Select filepath to Program Inventory file. "UPDATE" will update the program numbers in the file')))),         
        br(),
        fluidRow(column(6,fileInput('InventoryUpload', label=NULL, accept=c('.xlsx')))),
        fluidRow(column(2,actionButton('Inventory.XLSX',label='UPDATE')),
                 column(3,h4(strong(uiOutput('editprograminventory_upload.notice'))))),
        br(),
        fluidRow(column(12,h4(strong('Preview of Programs that will be Updated:')))),         
        fluidRow(column(12,DT::dataTableOutput('UPLOAD.Inventory.PreviewDT'))),
        br(),br(),br(),br(),br()
      )
```
